answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 62 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in velvet, queued in oasis, and signal publishes the wait time. A farm of 196 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3987 identities would post 620 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
